name: ras responsive element binding protein 1

function.text: RREB1 encodes ras-responsive element-binding protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
